title: Customer Support Automation
subtitle: Design support that answers, requests approval and hands off with evidence, while keeping account actions controlled.
theme: Agents and Copilots in Real Workflows
author: By Sourav Banerjee

practice_prompts.label: Discovery and scope fence
practice_prompts.hint: Which six areas do you ask about, which assumptions are safe, and what stays out of the first release?

practice_prompts.label: Trace the double charge
practice_prompts.hint: Follow the message through identity, routing, live billing, proposal, gateway and outcome. Who decides the refund?

practice_prompts.label: Billing timeout and timed-out refund
practice_prompts.hint: What blocks, what is pending, what the handoff carries, and when a retry is safe.

practice_prompts.label: Gate, rollout and cost
practice_prompts.hint: Which metrics veto a deflection win, what the go/no-go checklist holds, and how you answer the cost pivot.

rubric: Separates action authority (the deterministic gateway) from model confidence, and names the five gateway checks.
Fetches billing, orders and identity live before an account action and stamps the policy version.
Treats a timed-out refund as unknown, reconciles against the ledger and says the backend must honour the idempotency key.
Specifies the handoff fields, the stop reason and risk-prioritised queueing.
Sizes calls by workflow (4.2M model, 2.2M-2.4M retrieval) and judges value with NetValue, not deflection.
Launches agent-assist first, then reversible intents and one tool class at a time with a kill switch and named owners.
Asks '80 percent of what?' and expands only where safe automation and repeat contact hold.
